remarks: Tucked away on a quiet North Stamford cul-de-sac, this updated 3/4 bedroom, 3 bath contemporary offers great natural light, thoughtful updates, and a flexible layout that works for today's lifestyle. Step into the welcoming upper level entryway and take in the dramatic two-story wall of windows open to the living space below and framing peaceful views of the private, tree-lined yard. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious living room with fireplace and wet bar, as well as an updated en-suite primary bedroom with a spa-like bath and Juliet balcony. Head to the main level where the two-story windows fill the open dining room with natural light & sliders to the deck. The beautifully updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a large island flows into a warm and inviting family room with gas fireplace, built-ins, and sliders leading to a wraparound deck. Two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and laundry complete this level. The walk-out lower level offers incredible flexibility-a 4th bedroom, office, playroom, or guest space-with its own full bath, sliders to a patio, and ample storage. Easy access to oversized 2 car garage from the breezeway off the kitchen. The large yard is a nature lovers delight surrounded by trees to ensure privacy while you relax with your morning coffee. Walk to the Bye Preserve, Pound Ridge Conservancy for acres of hiking trails or the Pound Ridge Golf Club. Very low heating costs as this home has a high efficiency heat pump with propane setup.
